notes.title: New Level Design Preview
notes.content:
[h3]New Level Design Preview[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/5661c5614b84e8a7f733a42a4bb7e384ac3fa8c2.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/f54757052890012e12a2bf83855e5be0a2c6394b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/a50e30d787d67baaeed0f34980e9c98dd1b11a15.png"][/img][/p][p]These major changes will take a while but it’s a guaranteed new experience. A new flesh out take on grim diary.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/13efc29ae976f237c1576dad88a0c713e6c47870.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Retelling Story[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/2601d9e8c5864966ecf83ad5cc79f400680bb84e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/c2a2bcf357d590f4d64bd15012e1688538ec2d52.png"][/img][/p][p]With the new changes in level design the current story is not perfectly fit anymore. Some changes need to be made. But the whole premise is still untouched.[/p][p]

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/5535f21636556be4fa8ed42a85b80ff20717abb4.png"][/img][/p][p]
Grim Diary is heading in a new direction. And more open world oriented features. Bit by bit will make it come true.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Grim Diary 0.01v ~ Full Patch
notes.content:

 New Addition “Perks” System.(It's called rebounder before but scratch)  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/7d9b080097b86301788782b9b643b66c6ac6a26c.png"][/img][/p][p]Pick the perk the player wants to use.It cost Exchange points.[/p][p]Each character have their own unique perks

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/44262add16c168b7b75bf44e3e8bd590c5a33764.png"][/img][/p][p]To improve eli’s survivability and overall her archetype.

notes.title: 0.01v New Patch Update
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Removing Priority Effect Replace by Rebounder[/p][p][/p][p]Rebounder[/p][p]A player can choose passives to their liking. As the name implies, for every passive activate it will affect other stats of the character. Starting the journey with the unique items with these rebound effects.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/7e199a0d7df540c49617b815f514f80258d159b0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/13efc29ae976f237c1576dad88a0c713e6c47870.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks for supporting the Grim Diary Project.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/e5c0de690fdbb4f3c19af05f9d78b017aa503100.png"][/img]
[/p][p]Hello I’m Lepus the lone dev of this project I’ll keep polishing the game with more updates coming soon. Thank you for supporting the project.[/p][p][/p]
